oracle_provenance: Standard textbook statistical process control (SPC) Cpk formula; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded process capability index from declared spec limits and process mean/sigma; not an empirical control-chart validation of statistical control.

cases.question: For a perfectly centered process, does Cpk equal Cpu and Cpl and clear a 1.33 minimum?
When the process mean shifts toward the upper limit, does Cpk correctly take the smaller (constraining) side rather than an average?
Must an upper spec limit at or below the lower spec limit be rejected as an invalid specification?
Does halving the process sigma double the Cpk for the same centered process, confirming the model's own inverse relationship with variation?
